teacher.labels: Physical endpoint attachment graph, induced observable attachment graph, connection-cluster membership, cluster size/count and singleton/hidden censoring state.

teacher.source: Exact program construction compositions. P1b stores up to three same-node neighbor endpoints per visible primitive endpoint; sidecar marks direct endpoint support at the frozen 0.25 m band.
teacher.student_forbidden_inputs: No sensor frame, world/primitive/node identity, TNG, absolute pose, future frame, checkpoint or model output is read. Construction identity is used only to define the already-materialized Teacher relation.
teacher.unexplored_port_policy: Not part of this audit or perception Teacher.
teacher.valid_mask: A physical connection is observable only when both endpoints have direct support. Hidden endpoints remain unknown, never negative; a lone observed member of a multi-endpoint physical cluster is reported as censored singleton and cannot commit an edge.
